subject_uz: Fargʻona viloyati Beshariq, Oʻzbekiston, Rishton va Dangʻara tumanlaridagi 16 ta MFY hududida 28,78 gektar maydonda mahallalar markazining master-rejasini ishlab chiqish

requirements.summary_uz: Fargʻona viloyatidagi 16 ta MFY hududida jami 28,78 gektar maydonda mahallalar markazining master-rejasini ishlab chiqish.
requirements.summary_en: Prepare the master plan of neighbourhood centres on a total of 28.78 ha across 16 mahallas in Fergana region.
requirements.quote: jami 28,78 gektar yer maydonida Yangi O„zbekiston qiyofasidagi mahallalar markazining master-rejasini ishlab chiqish

requirements.summary_uz: Eng yuqori narx 376 521 120 so'm (QQS bilan); undan yuqori takliflar ko'rib chiqilmaydi.
requirements.summary_en: Maximum price is 376,521,120 UZS including VAT; higher offers are not considered.
requirements.quote: Ushbu qiymatdan ortiq qiymatdagi takliflar qabul qilinmaydi va koʼrib chiqilmaydi.

requirements.summary_en: Works to be completed by 1 December 2026.

requirements.summary_uz: Shartnoma qiymatining 30 foizi miqdorida avans to'lanadi.
requirements.summary_en: An advance of 30% of the contract value is paid.
requirements.quote: ishlar umumiy joriy qiymatining 30% miqdorida avans toʼlovini oʼtkazib beradi.

requirements.summary_uz: Qolgan to'lov viloyat moliya boshqarmasi mablag' ajratganidan keyin, qiymatning 70 foizi doirasida amalga oshiriladi.
requirements.summary_en: The rest is paid, up to 70% of the contract value, only after the regional finance office allocates funds.
requirements.quote: obʼekt umumiy shartnomaviy qiymatining 70 foizi doirasida amalga oshiriladi

requirements.summary_uz: Faoliyat huquqini beruvchi hujjatlar kerak (3-toifa litsenziya, akkreditatsiya sertifikatlari, ruxsatnomalar).
requirements.summary_en: Documents giving the right to operate are required (category-3 licence, accreditation certificates, permits).
requirements.quote: faoliyatni amalga oshirish huquqini beruvchi hujjatlar to„g„risidagi ma‟lumotlar (3-toifa lisenziya, akkreditatsiya sertifikatlari, ruxsatnomalar yoki boshqa hujjatlar)

requirements.summary_uz: Oxirgi ikki yilda bajarilgan ishlarni qabul qilish dalolatnomalari talab qilinadi.
requirements.summary_en: Acceptance acts for works completed in the last two years are required.
requirements.quote: oxirgi ikki yilda muvaffaqiyatli amalga oshirgan ishlarni qabul qilish bo„yicha dalolatnomalarning mavjudligi

requirements.summary_uz: 300 gektardan yuqori hududlar bo'yicha rejalashtirish hujjatlarini ishlab chiqish tajribasi talab qilinadi.
requirements.summary_en: Experience preparing planning documents for territories over 300 ha is required.
requirements.quote: Hududlarda 300,0 gektardan yuqori bo„lgan hudud uchun hududiy iqtisodiy-ijtimoiy rivojlantirish va hududni arxitekturaviy hamda shaharsozlik jihatdan rejalashtirish hujjatlarini ishlab chiqish bo„yicha tajribaga ega bo„lishi lozim

requirements.summary_uz: Hududiy rejalashtirish hujjatlari tajribasi: 3 ta ish - 3 ball, 7 ta - 7 ball, 10 ta - 10 ball; bo'lmasa chetlatilishi mumkin.
requirements.summary_en: Planning-document experience: 3 works 3 points, 7 works 7, 10 works 10; none may lead to exclusion.
requirements.quote: 3 ta taqdim etilgan ishga – 3 ball; 7 ta taqdim etilgan ishga – 7 ball; 10 ta taqdim etilgan ishga – 10 ball

requirements.summary_uz: Moliyaviy ko'rsatkichlar: oxirgi 3 yillik moliyaviy natija va balans (F-1, F-2) uchun 5 ball.
requirements.summary_en: Financial indicators: three-year results and balance sheets (F-1, F-2) score 5 points.
requirements.quote: Oxirgi 3 yillik moliyaviy natija, buxgalteriya balans (F-1, F-2) hujjatlari – 5 ball

requirements.summary_uz: Xodimlar: 2 ta bosh muhandis va 1 ta bosh arxitektor uchun 5 ball, 6 ta qo'shimcha xodim uchun 3 ball.
requirements.summary_en: Staff: 2 chief engineers and 1 chief architect score 5 points; 6 additional staff score 3 points.
requirements.quote: Loyiha bosh muxandisi - 2 ta, loyiha bosh arxitektori- 1 ta – 5 ball

requirements.summary_uz: Texnik baholash sifati (tasavvur, maqsad, yondashuv) uchun ball beriladi.
requirements.summary_en: Technical quality of the vision, aim and approach is scored.

flags.quote: 9 - Hududlarda 300,0 gektardan yuqori bo„lgan hudud uchun ishlab chiqilgan master rejalar (Shaharsozlik kengashi xulosasi ilova qilinsin)
flags.explanation_uz: Mezon 7 bo'yicha 10 balldan 9 tasi 300 gektardan katta hududlar uchun ishlab chiqilgan master-rejalarga beriladi, 300 gektargacha bo'lgan ishlarga esa atigi 1 ball. Mazkur xaridda hudud 28,78 gektar, ya'ni taxminan o'n baravar kichik. Bu talab mos hajmdagi ish tajribasiga ega bo'lgan ijrochilarni deyarli butunlay balldan mahrum qiladi va hujjat topshirilmasa ishtirokchi keyingi bosqichdan chetlatiladi.
flags.explanation_en: Nine of the 10 points on criterion 7 go to master plans for territories above 300 ha, while works up to 300 ha get only 1 point. This lot covers 28.78 ha, about ten times smaller. The clause leaves firms with right-sized experience almost without points, and a bidder who submits nothing is removed from the next stage.
flags.rewrite_uz: Hududlarda 30 gektargacha, 30 dan 100 gektargacha va 100 gektardan yuqori maydon uchun bajarilgan master-reja ishlari (Shaharsozlik kengashi xulosasi bilan) - mutanosib ballar: masalan, 28,78 gektarga yaqin yoki undan katta hudud uchun tajribaga to'liq ball.
flags.rewrite_en: Master-plan works completed for areas up to 30 ha, 30-100 ha and over 100 ha (with an Urban Planning Council opinion), with proportional points, giving full points for experience on areas close to or larger than 28.78 ha.

flags.quote: Buyurtmachi va gʼolib boʼlgan qatnashchi bilan shartnoma imzolangan kundan boshlanadi. 1.5. Ishlarni Bajarish muddati: 01.12.2026 gacha.
flags.explanation_uz: Tanlov hujjatida ishlar shartnoma imzolangan kundan boshlanib 2026-yil 1-dekabrgacha bajarilishi kerakligi yozilgan, takliflar esa 24-noyabrgacha qabul qilinadi. Qolgan muddat taxminan bir haftadan oshmaydi, bu 16 ta mahallani qamrab olgan master-reja uchun real emas. Lot ma'lumotlarida muddat 7 oy deb ko'rsatilgan, ya'ni hujjatlar bir-biriga zid; buni aniqlashtirish kerak.
flags.explanation_en: The tender document says works run from the contract signing date and must finish by 1 December 2026, while bids are accepted until 24 November. That leaves about a week, which is not realistic for a master plan covering 16 mahallas. The lot entry gives 7 months, so the documents contradict each other and this should be clarified.
flags.rewrite_uz: Ishlarni bajarish muddati: shartnoma imzolangan kundan boshlab 7 oy (yoki buyurtmachi asoslagan boshqa real muddat).
flags.rewrite_en: Completion period: 7 months from the contract signing date (or another realistic period justified by the customer).

documents_needed_uz: Ta'sis hujjatlari va davlat ro'yxatidan o'tganlik guvohnomasi
Faoliyat huquqini beruvchi hujjatlar: 3-toifa litsenziya, guvohnoma, akkreditatsiya sertifikatlari yoki korxona nizomi
Oxirgi ikki yilda bajarilgan hududiy rejalashtirish ishlari bo'yicha qabul qilish dalolatnomalari
300 gektardan yuqori hududlar bo'yicha master-rejalar va Shaharsozlik kengashi xulosasi (bo'lsa)
Buxgalteriya balansi (F-1, F-2), oxirgi 3 yillik moliyaviy natija, to'lovga qodirlik va bank aylanma mablag'i ma'lumoti
Majburiy ijro byurosi bazalarida bajarilmagan sud qarorlari yo'qligi to'g'risida ma'lumotnoma
Mutaxassislar to'g'risida ma'lumotnoma (rahbar, 2 ta bosh muhandis, bosh arxitektor, 6 ta xodim) va diplom hamda hujjat nusxalari
Hudud konsepsiyasi loyihasi va texnik taklif (tasavvur, maqsad, yondashuv)
Manfaatlar to'qnashuvi va affillanganlik holatlari yo'qligi to'g'risida ariza
Xorijiy davlatlar va xalqaro tashkilotlar sanksiyalari qo'llanilmaganligi to'g'risida ma'lumot
Tanlov qoidalariga rioya etish to'g'risidagi ariza
Zakalat kiritilganligini tasdiqlovchi hujjat yoki bank kafolati
